review_comments: I have noticed that the source code almost use `var` instead of `let` in function scope. I wanna know why there use `let`?

`var` is mainly used in hot code paths to optimize performance. This is setup code that only runs once so it's okay to use `let` since it's the more idiomatic way to declare variables in modern JavaScript.
Can you add a comment on why we are not using bind()? This pattern is repeated enough that I think it might be better to write an utility to generate these.

This could fit?

> we need the fastify object that we are producing so we apply a lazy loading of the function otherwise we should bind it after the declaration
